component.name: ReplayNES
component.summary: Record, rewind and replay NES play

description.p: ReplayNES records NES play frame by frame: rewind, fast-forward, slow motion and frame stepping never change what was recorded. Built on the Nestopia UE core with display-locked, low-latency pacing.
On the Steam Deck, "Add to Steam" puts ReplayNES into the Steam library with its own capsule, hero, logo and icon artwork.

Shoulder buttons in play: hold L and press R to pause (the seek bar), hold R and press L to switch slow 1/2 on or off. While paused they still step a frame forward / back. Also: builds with GCC 11 again.

The picture never stays frozen (display watchdog with fallback and an on-screen picture rate), the CRT display shows RF snow with no signal and a power-on effect (also in CRT videos), and the CRT picture is now exactly 8:7. Buttons pressed during the resume countdown reach the game. Shoulder buttons no longer misfire in play: hold L + R to step forward, R + L to step back, L or R + START to pause. Also: a Stop Practice button (Y toggles practice), face buttons shown by position, and a "ReplayNES Version" settings page that includes Updates.

Video-deck style controls: playing is recording, with no REC badge and no takes to manage. Releasing Rewind counts down 3-2-1 and plays on ("Retrying from here"); Undo (L3) brings back the previous run for 10 seconds; in Playback any game button plays from there. "Make Video" replaces MP4 export with a one-screen dialog (range, quality, estimated size). Also: one-time tips for new players, flash reduction that only reduces real flashes, and a display watchdog that recovers a stalled or broken CRT picture.

MP4 exports over 4 GiB are no longer truncated (all platforms write a temporary file and check it before renaming), hardware encoders with automatic software fallback, a bit rate choice (Light / Standard / High) with an estimated file size, a much faster CRT display, and the ReplayNES Test Cartridge with an "Add Test Cartridge" button in the library.

VHS-style rewind back to A with a 3-2-1 countdown for practice, VTR noise while rewinding, Y/X shortcuts on the paused seek bar, a fix for the purple tint on still CRT pictures, and in-app controller-operable dialogs on macOS.
Stepping forward while paused no longer starts a new take, the HOME button can no longer be assigned, "Pause after rewind" is off by default, clickable breadcrumbs, and Retry > Restart Recording.
New Quick Menu (L+R) with six categories, redesigned controls (east confirms by default), seek-bar A/B markers for practice, and a game library with a built-in title database.
Shared desktop frontend with the new native Windows app; controller glyph fixes.
Built-in on-screen keyboard for the Steam Deck controller, and Rename (Y) on the Bookmarks and Practice lists.
